hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && if grep -Eq '"stop_hook_active" *: *true'; then exit 0; fi; pnpm -s lint:fix >/dev/null 2>&1; { pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint; } >&2 || exit 2

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && (pnpm -s test:changed >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '{"systemMessage":"Related unit tests passed"}' || echo '{"systemMessage":"Related unit tests failed. Run pnpm test:changed to see why."}')
